input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: No minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic appears anywhere in the Base Terms: searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "volume" return nothing on point. Under § 4.1 Charges are only for Services ordered under Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), i.e. fees for usage or ordered services only, which matches our preferred position. § 11.5 Capacity Planning imposes no usage floor or cap on Customer — it merely allocates responsibility to Customer for sizing and requesting capacity changes. Customer also retains an exit under § 3.4, terminating the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for convenience at month end on one month's notice, subject only to early termination charges "if any" specified in Attachment A / Service Option Attachments (not part of this document). No redline required; we would review Attachment A and each Order Form for any committed volumes or early termination charges before signature.
